# Local implementation artifacts

This directory is **gitignored**. Use it for durable, machine-local implementation process files that should not enter the repo.

Committed product truth stays in `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/`.

## Suggested layout

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `tasks.md` | Full task map / backlog (phases, status) |
| `runbook.md` | How you execute work day to day |
| `progress.md` | Current focus, blockers, last session notes |
| `spikes/` | Scratch notes from spikes (optional) |

Bootstrap copies may live next to this README after you generate them once; re-copy from `docs/templates/` if you wipe `.local/`.
